description: Fetch a Hugging Face user or organization profile: display name, PRO flag, follower/following counts, avatar URL, and the profile's published models plus dataset and Space counts. user accepts a HF username or organization name (e.g. deepseek-ai or HuggingFaceFW). Reads the profile page DOM plus HF's internal author API from the browser; no login required.

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: HF username or organization name (e.g. deepseek-ai).
